title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 3: who rebuilt which gates and sections of the wall of Jerusalem.

questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:1 says Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests and built the sheep gate.

answers.text: Eliashib the high priest and the priests
Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah

questions.text: Which gate did the sons of Hassenaah build?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:3 says the sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate.

questions.text: What is said about the nobles of the Tekoites?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:5 says their nobles didn't put their necks to the Lord's work.

answers.text: They paid for all the timber
They didn't put their necks to the Lord's work
They built the tower of Hananel
They guarded the workers at night

questions.text: What was Hananiah, who made repairs next to Uzziel?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:8 says Hananiah was one of the perfumers.

questions.text: Who made repairs together with Shallum the son of Hallohesh?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:12 says Shallum made repairs, he and his daughters.

questions.text: Which gate did Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repair?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:13 says they repaired the valley gate and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.
Nehemiah 3:14 says Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate.

questions.text: Next to which garden was the wall of the pool of Shelah that Shallun repaired?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:15 says the wall of the pool of Shelah was by the king's garden.

questions.text: How did Baruch the son of Zabbai repair his portion?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:20 says Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion.

questions.text: Where did the temple servants live?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 3:26 says the temple servants lived in Ophel.
